issue: सत्युग त्रेता द्वापर मध्ये कलयुग राज सवाया — the line has no verb for the first three ages; सवाया is 'a quarter more' (Platts sawāyā = sawaiyā).
our reading: Your reign has stood through the Satya, Tretā and Dvāpara ages, and in the Kali age it is greater by a quarter.
alternatives: Among (मध्ये) the ages Satya, Tretā and Dvāpara, it is in the Kali age that your reign is greatest.
